title: Courier parcel → CBI/Customs digital arrest
why_scam: No Indian agency arrests over a video call, holds you on Skype, or asks you to transfer money to a 'verification account'. RBI and courts have no such account.
safe_action: Hang up immediately. Never pay or share OTP. Report to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Fake CBI/ED/Cyber-Cell officer video call
why_scam: Real agencies serve notices in writing under CrPC 41A, never via WhatsApp, Skype or video call. Suspects are never 'digitally arrested'.
safe_action: Do not join the call. Do not transfer any amount. Verify with the local police station in person.
source: CBI public notice on impersonation calls (2024)

title: Guaranteed-return / VIP tips trading group
why_scam: SEBI does not permit anyone to guarantee returns. VIP groups on Telegram/WhatsApp with 'guaranteed profit' are pump-and-dump or outright ponzi schemes.
safe_action: Ignore. Only invest through SEBI-registered brokers. Verify advisor at sebi.gov.in/intermediaries.
source: SEBI investor caution on unregistered advisors

title: Fake IPO/pre-IPO allotment scam
why_scam: IPO allotment is done by the registrar based on bids; no one 'confirms' allotment in advance in return for a booking amount.
safe_action: Only apply via ASBA through your bank/broker. Delete these messages.

title: 'Account will be blocked' KYC / PAN link scam
why_scam: Real banks never send blocking warnings via SMS/WhatsApp links and never ask you to complete KYC through a random URL or by sharing OTP.
safe_action: Do not click the link. Call the number on the back of your card or visit your branch to check KYC status.
source: RBI Sachet portal — beware of KYC fraud

title: OTP / CVV / debit card details phishing
why_scam: No bank, RBI, or payment app ever needs your OTP, PIN or CVV. Sharing these transfers money OUT of your account, not in.
safe_action: Never share OTP/PIN/CVV. If you already did, call your bank's fraud helpline and block the card immediately.

title: FedEx/DHL 'parcel held at customs' scam
why_scam: Courier companies never call to demand cash for customs clearance. Customs duties are paid to the delivery agent or the courier's official portal, never via random UPI IDs.
safe_action: Ignore. If you're expecting a parcel, log into the courier's official app or website to check status.
source: I4C advisory on 'fake FedEx call' scam

title: Like/rate task scam with 'prepaid task' upsell
why_scam: The first small payouts are bait. Once you're hooked, the 'prepaid task' step asks you to deposit money that is never returned.
safe_action: No real employer asks you to pay in order to earn. Delete the message and leave the group.

title: Instant loan with upfront processing fee
why_scam: RBI-registered lenders never ask for an advance processing fee via UPI before releasing a loan. That fee vanishes; the loan never arrives.
safe_action: Verify the lender on the RBI website. Never pay upfront to receive a loan.

title: KBC / Jio / Amazon lottery-winner scam
why_scam: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Real prizes never require you to pay 'processing fees' or 'GST' upfront to receive them.
safe_action: Ignore. Do not share Aadhaar/PAN or pay any fee. Report to 1930.
source: I4C consumer alert on lottery frauds

title: Fake Microsoft/Apple tech-support with remote-access
why_scam: Microsoft and Apple never call end-users about infections. Installing AnyDesk/TeamViewer for a caller hands them your bank sessions.
safe_action: Do not call the number. Do not install any remote-access tool for a stranger. Uninstall AnyDesk/TeamViewer if you already did.
source: Microsoft consumer advisory on tech-support scams

title: 'Wrong transfer, please refund' UPI collect scam
why_scam: You never enter a UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. Approving a 'collect request' or scanning a QR to 'get a refund' actually SENDS money out of your account.
safe_action: Reject the request. Only enter a UPI PIN when you are paying, never when receiving.

title: OLX/marketplace 'send you advance' payment trick
why_scam: The 'buyer' sends a UPI collect request framed as an advance. Approving it debits your account instead of crediting it.
safe_action: Meet marketplace buyers in person. Only accept payment as a real credit into your account, not via a collect request you approve.

title: Romance scam with 'stuck at airport / gift held' hook
why_scam: The 'partner' has never met you in person and always has an emergency requiring a money transfer to a third-party UPI or bank account.
safe_action: Do not send money to someone you have not met in person. Report the profile on the platform where you met.

title: Cloned-voice family emergency scam
why_scam: Publicly-available voice samples can be cloned in seconds. The urgency + secrecy is engineered so you don't verify with the real person.
safe_action: Hang up. Call the family member back on their known number BEFORE sending any money.
source: I4C advisory on AI voice-cloning fraud (2024)

title: 'Do not tell family, stay isolated' pressure pattern
why_scam: Isolating the victim from family/friends is the single most reliable marker of a digital-arrest or similar high-pressure fraud.
safe_action: The moment someone tells you not to speak to your family, HANG UP. Call a family member.

title: Phishing link disguised as bank domain
why_scam: Real banks use their official domains (sbi.co.in, hdfcbank.com, …). Any KYC 'update' link on a .xyz / .info / lookalike domain is phishing.
safe_action: Do not click. Type the bank's official URL into your browser and check status there.

title: Impersonated foreign-fund / celebrity trading platform
why_scam: These use famous names to signal legitimacy but the 'platform' is a fake app or website that shows fictitious profits and blocks all withdrawals.
safe_action: Do not deposit. Verify any platform on sebi.gov.in. Withdraw immediately if you already deposited.

title: 'Redelivery fee' India Post phishing
why_scam: India Post never charges a small 'redelivery fee' via a random SMS link. These links harvest card details or install malware.
safe_action: Ignore the SMS. If expecting a parcel, use the tracking number on indiapost.gov.in.

title: Extreme urgency + secrecy signal
why_scam: Legitimate institutions give reasonable timeframes; extreme urgency is engineered to stop you thinking or verifying.
safe_action: Pause. Any request that pressures you to act 'in the next 10 minutes' deserves a call to a trusted person before you act.

title: Any unsolicited request for OTP/password/PIN
why_scam: OTP, password and PIN exist specifically because they must NEVER be shared. Anyone asking for one is impersonating a real service.
safe_action: Do not share. Real staff never need to ask.

title: 'Verification code we send' account-takeover trick
indicators: read out the code we sent
why_scam: The 'code we sent' is actually your own password-reset code. Sharing it hands the attacker your account.
safe_action: Never read out a code that arrived on your phone to a caller. Real support never asks for it.
